newsitem.title: UK: Camas higher following trading statement.
newsitem.headline: Camas higher following trading statement.

text.p: Shares in Camas Plc touched a 12-month high on Thursday, against the weaker market trend, following the release of an "encouraging" trading statement on Tuesday, market makers said.
Shares in the building materials group, which reported full-year pre-tax profits of 22.825 million stg on Tueday, down from 24.103 million a year ago, were up 3p to 84-1/2p by 0835 GMT.
"The trading statement was encouraging," one market maker said. People are hoping that we'll see a stronger UK housing market this year, which should be good news for the company."
Camas said in a statement that business in 1997 had started well due to continuing good markets in the U.S. and "the pick-up in the UK housing market."

The company reported earnings per share (EPS) of 5.11 pence for the year ending December 31, 1996. Consensus estimates for the year ending December 31, 1997 call for an EPS of 5.70 pence, according to data from Reuters Securities 3000.
